## 2. ICLR Rebuttal Ready

*Rewrite beats naive append by ~9 F1 points; token‑budget blowout at day 20 for append.*  
- Prepare rebuttal text (include clean results).  
- Deadline: **03 Aug 2026** (ML submission window). |  

## 3. Overnight Idea  

> **Integrate consolidation into the rewrite operation itself (hybrid rewrite‑+‑consolidation)**: prior hypotheses (conf = 0.78) predict > 5 % gain over plain rewrite while reducing token growth, giving a stronger case for both ICLR & workshop paper.
